phase: Proposed class settlement awaiting approval decision
phaseDetail: The official King v. Monsanto administrator lists a September 14, 2026 fairness hearing. When checked September 15, the site did not display a final-approval notice, so this record does not claim that approval was granted. The separate federal MDL remains before Judge Vince Chhabria, and the Supreme Court issued its Durnell preemption decision June 25, 2026.

settlements.label: King v. Monsanto proposed class settlement
settlements.detail: The proposed King v. Monsanto class settlement provides up to $7.25 billion, subject to final approval. The administrator checked September 14, 2026 lists the fairness hearing that day at 9:30 a.m. Central and does not announce final approval. June 4 objection and opt-out deadlines have passed. Registration and claim deadlines depend on later approval and appeal events; they are separate from state lawsuit deadlines.
settlements.individualClaims: Class terms and later approval events control; no automatic individual award.
